meta.title: Untameable - Understand. Design. Build.
meta.description: Solution architecture, forward deployed engineering, and software engineering. More efficiency and more revenue, with the tools you already use.

title: Understand. Design. Build.
subtitle: Untameable helps you identify bottlenecks, design practical solutions, and turn them into working software. The goal is simple: improve efficiency and help your business grow.

solutionArchitecture.title: Solution Architecture
solutionArchitecture.text: Understanding requirements, exploring possibilities, and designing practical technical solutions.

forwardDeployed.title: Forward Deployed Engineering
forwardDeployed.text: Working directly with clients to solve problems, build prototypes, and integrate solutions into existing workflows.

softwareEngineering.title: Software Engineering
softwareEngineering.text: Building and maintaining applications, platforms, and integrations.

whatWorks.title: Do what works
whatWorks.text: We keep things simple and effective for you and your users.

weCollaborate.title: Collaborate
weCollaborate.text: We think strategically with you and support you from idea to execution.

weSolve.title: Solve
weSolve.text: We let ourselves be challenged in finding effective solutions.

weDeliver.title: Develop
weDeliver.text: We develop and improve software from concept to product.

process.title: Our approach
process.intro: Four steps. Then we run them again. Each pass is there to move your people and your organization forward.
process.loop: Finetune is not a finish line. It is Audit, Proof, and Implement again.

audit.title: Audit
audit.text: Together we follow how time and money actually move, and where a small change does the most.

proof.title: Proof
proof.text: A small working example, in your own tools. If it does not work, we stop.

implement.title: Implement
implement.text: The change that works goes into the software your team already uses.

finetune.title: Finetune
finetune.text: We develop it further. The same steps, on the next bottleneck.

trulyHelpPeople: Truly helping people and organizations move forward!

byRemovingObstacles.firstPart: We deliver practical solutions that deliver value,
byRemovingObstacles.secondPart: enabling you to make progress and grow your organization.

shortIntroduction.title: Who I am
shortIntroduction.text: I'm a software engineer and solutions architect with over 10 years of experience. I enjoy understanding complex problems, finding practical solutions, and building them.

getStarted.title: Let's take the next step
getStarted.text: An exploratory conversation is free. Tell me what is going on, or call or email me.
